reviewScope: Read all 117 materialized original-bank questions, choices, keys and explanations in bounded outputs. finding: The fixed four-dimension generator used valid actions and assessments from other topics as distractors. Broad stems frequently admitted several clinically reasonable answers; rationales also repeated across four distinct questions.
